Rae (Growth): Quick sync — planning a 25m "microcase" webinar for EU/APAC. Need a tight run-of-show, speaker order, and lead routing. Keep it practical.
Maya - Events: Proposal: 2x8m demos + 5m live Q&A + 2m intro = 23m. Add 2m closing. Will handle invites and greenroom.
Omar (Design): I'll prepare a 1-page speaker prompt per demo and 2-slide mini templates (problem + demo screenshot). Who's speaking?
Sofia (Eng Ops): For leads: registration asks: deployment interest (hosted/dedicated/private) + monthly inference spend bracket. Map to SFDC tag: microcase_eu_apac_2026.
Rae (Growth): Add hidden param "workload_type" (chat/summarization/embeds) so solutions can triage.
Maya - Events: Rehearsals: full dress 48h prior (30m), tech check 15m prior. CueBot can post T-48h, T-30m, T-10m reminders.
CueBot: Scheduled cues set. Will post run-of-show link in chat at T-30m.
Omar (Design): Need 50-word bios and a fallback clip per speaker.
Rae (Growth): Speakers: Lina (Platform PM), Akio (Customer Eng), Priya (Infra). Lina will prep a 90s pre-recorded clip.
Sofia (Eng Ops): SLA: Leads >$3k/month -> SDR ping in Slack + owner assigned within 24h. Others -> 72h.
Maya - Events: I'll pin the Google Drive run-of-show once uploaded. Tentative rehearsal slots: Tue 09:00 UTC, Thu 02:00 UTC. RSVP please.
Rae (Growth): Owners recap: Maya (events), Sofia (lead routing), Omar (slides), Rae (moderation + copy). I'll draft registration copy tomorrow. :sparkles:
